You see a mailbox.
Royal Tibia Mail.

Location

Mailboxes are found in every hometown, in or near depots, and other locations on the street throughout each town.

Notes

A mailbox is used to send Parcels or Letters to yourself or other players. See the page on Sending Parcels for more detailed instructions.


There also are some Royal Mailboxes,which are close to Hunting Places, but you must have completed a quest in order to be able to use them. That way, you don't have to drag a Loot Bag all the way to the depot. Also, there is a mailbox in Vega, near Santa's House. This one, however, cannot be used.

You cannot use royal mailboxes (usually near hunting grounds) unless you have completed the entire Postman Quest.


Mailboxes Near Hunting Areas

Available Mailboxes (not locked)

  • Three mailboxes west of the great hall of the Emperor of Beregar.
  • Fibula town.
  • Folda, Top of mountain (location (32009, 31564, 7)).
  • Isle of Evil, outside the entrance to the castle.
  • Outlaw Camp, underground (here).

Royal Mailboxes (locked)

  • Calassa.
  • Cyclopolis, far north-east part of first level (here (33271, 31656, 8)).
  • Drefia, north beach, south of the main building (just east of the ship, here (32995, 32447, 7)).
  • Formorgar Mines, just left of the hoist on the second floor of the mines.
  • At the entrance of the Fury Dungeon.
  • Four locations in Kazordoon Dwarf Mines, all surrounding the Mine Hub(here (32454, 31969, 10)); you can also find one on the surface here (32535, 31971, 7).
  • Laguna Islands (a.k.a. Turtle Islands) at the center of the first island (here (32386, 32950, 7))after the teleport from Meriana.
  • Minotaur Pyramid near Darashia, ground floor, south side (here (33307, 32292, 7)).
  • Mintwallin, north part of town here (32423, 32095, 15).
  • Mistrock, west of the boat (here (32615, 31434, 7)).
  • Nargor On the second level in the main cave, just up the stairs to the right of the two docked boats and in the room to the right (here (32008, 32862, 5)).
  • Orc Fortress, inside the fort on the main level, all the way to the east (here (32970, 31778, 7)).
  • Raider Camps, north of Ragnir.
  • Razachai, in a room in the magistracy building just north of NPC Zlak. You can travel quickly to the aforementioned Zao Rebel Camp and buy Parcels and Labels there.
  • Robson's Isle, next to Robson. He sells Parcels and Labels.
  • Shadowthorn, at the southern part of the elven fortress. Go down to -1 at the shown area (33084, 32189, 7) on the map, you should find the mailbox a few steps north.
  • Talahu (also known as Hydra Island) has a mailbox in its Teleportation Hub here (31921, 32652, 8).
  • Vengoth, outside the castle.
  • Zao Rebel Camp, southwest of NPC Chartan. You can also buy Parcels and Labels in the area, from the NPC Ezean.
  • Rascacoon (here (33724, 31329, 7))
